definitions.gloss: idealistic argument; an argument that ignores practical constraints
definitions.explanation: A position that is admirable in principle but takes no account of what is actually possible. Almost always used critically, to dismiss a proposal as unworkable.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{理想論|りそうろん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない。
examples.english: That is nothing more than an idealistic argument.

examples.japanese: {理想論|りそうろん}⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}しない→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧。
examples.english: Nothing but idealistic arguments will not solve the problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{人手|ひとで}→人手：25438_hitode⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧⟦{現状|げんじょう}→現状：02721_genjou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{理想論|りそうろん}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Given the current shortage of both budget and staff, the plan was called wishful theorizing.

notes:
⟦{理想|りそう}→理想：03676_risou⟧ (ideal) + ⟦{論|ろん}→〜論：04017_ron⟧ (argument, theory). The ⟦{論|ろん}→〜論：04017_ron⟧ suffix names a position or line of argument, as in ⟦{悲観論|ひかんろん}→悲観論：30516_hikanron⟧ (pessimistic view) or ⟦{楽観論|らっかんろん}→楽観論：30517_rakkanron⟧ (optimistic view).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {理想論|りそうろん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない: to be nothing but an ideal
- {理想論|りそうろん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{語|かた}る→語る：01930_kataru⟧: to talk in ideals
- {理想論|りそうろん}⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧: nothing but idealism
- ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{理想論|りそうろん}: mere idealism

REGISTER:
The word carries built-in criticism, so it is not used of one's own proposal except self-deprecatingly. Common in debate, business meetings, and political commentary.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {現実論|げんじつろん}: realistic argument — the usual term set against it
- ⟦{机上|きじょう}の{空論|くうろん}→机上の空論：30514_kijounokuuron⟧: armchair theory — stronger, implying the idea collapses on contact with reality
